newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopia charges 84 with Red Terror killings.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopia charges 84 with Red Terror killings.

text.p: Eighty-four former Ethiopian Marxist officials appeared in court on Friday charged with murdering 131 people during the Red Terror of 1977 and 1978.
They include Lieutenant Colonel Nadew Zekarias, a former regional administrator and member of the Dergue, the military junta which ruled Ethiopia from 1974 to 1991.

The prosecutors said the 84, as the heads of special Red Terror Committees and revolutionary guards during the Red Terror campaign, killed their victims in the belief they were political opponents. They gave 279 others tough prison sentences.
Supporters of ousted dictator Mengistu Haile Mariam killed up to 100,000 people during the campaign.
The charge sheet said one defendant, Master Technician Tesfaye Gebre-Medhin, ordered the bodies of his 50 victims thrown on roadsides and squares as a warning to others.
Colonel Nadew is accused of killing 31 people while working as administrator in the northern province of Wollo.
But his lawyers say Nadew should not face the charges because he is already on trial on genocide charges in a separate case along with 70 other Dergue officials.
